name: Getting started
items: What is USFans, and how does a USFans spreadsheet help?

USFans is a shopping-agent platform for researching and purchasing third-party listings. Its published process covers ordering, delivery to a warehouse in China, inspection, and onward international shipment. A USFans spreadsheet helps you discover listings before you place an order; it does not replace the seller’s specifications or your USFans account.
https://usfans.com/faq
How do I buy on USFans from a spreadsheet product link?

Choose an item, open its product page, then follow the Buy on USFans link. On USFans, confirm the exact listing, selected style, size, quantity and current price before paying. After warehouse arrival, review the item and submit an international parcel when ready. Our buying guide explains the sequence; payment and order management happen on USFans.
https://usfans.com/beginner-guide
Is USFans Findsheet the official USFans website?

No. USFans Findsheet is an independent discovery site. We organize product links and buying information, but do not sell these goods, process payments or operate a warehouse. Use the official USFans account and support channels for order-specific help.
Which product categories are in this USFans spreadsheet?

The directory covers all 11 product categories in the main FindSpreadsheet catalog: shoes, sweatshirts, T-shirts, jackets, pants and shorts, headwear, accessories, jerseys, short sets, electronics and other items. Spreadsheet is the browsing hub; Category Guides explains how to compare each type of item.

name: QC & product photos
items: What are USFans QC photos?

QC means quality-control inspection. USFans describes checking goods after they arrive at its warehouse and providing inspection photos. A product-page notice currently advertises three to seven free HD photos. Check what is actually available for your order; a seller’s catalog image on this site is not a photo of the item in your warehouse.
https://usfans.com/product/3/7719230381
What should I check in USFans warehouse QC photos?

Compare the order’s selected colour, size labels, visible construction, accessories and any measurement evidence with the listing. For shoes, inspect both shoes and sizing labels; for clothing, compare measurements rather than relying only on a size letter. Photos show visible details and cannot establish long-term durability or verify every material claim.
Does this USFans QC finder already show my warehouse photos?

No. The QC tool on this preview is awaiting its shared main-project interface. The product gallery contains source listing photos. To inspect your own purchase, use your USFans warehouse account. Do not assume another buyer’s QC images verify your seller, selected option or exact order.
Can I return an item after seeing its USFans QC photos?

An official product notice says a return request can be made within five days of warehouse arrival, with agents negotiating with the seller. Eligibility and acceptance still depend on the item and applicable conditions. Review photos promptly, check the current after-sales option in your account, and act before international shipping.
https://usfans.com/product/3/7719230381

name: Shipping & warehouse
items: How is USFans shipping cost calculated?

The beginner guide says the shipping deposit uses estimated weight, shipping method and destination. Final billing uses the package size and weight verified by the carrier, and a difference can be credited back to the USFans account. Review the live quote and optional packaging services; this site does not offer a universal per-kilogram rate.
https://usfans.com/beginner-guide
Does the product price include international shipping?

Treat the listing amount and the international-parcel payment as separate parts of your budget. Confirm domestic delivery, service charges, packaging, optional services and the final shipping quote on the platform. Dollar prices on product pages use USFans USD values when available and may vary by option. They are estimates, not the total delivered cost.
https://usfans.com/beginner-guide
Can I combine USFans finds into one parcel?

USFans describes selecting warehouse items and consolidating them into a parcel for international delivery. Check the available route and compatibility of the actual items before combining them. Packing dimensions, weight and item restrictions can change the available options; combining items does not automatically guarantee a cheaper shipment.
https://usfans.com/faq
How long can items stay in the USFans warehouse?

The official storage article currently states 90 days for purchasing-agent parcels and 60 days for forwarding parcels, counted from Warehoused status. It warns that goods may be treated as abandoned and destroyed when the limit passes without shipment or feedback. Check each order’s deadline and the current policy in your account.
https://usfans.com/help/HCON_STATIC_071
How long does USFans shipping take, and is every item eligible?

Check the estimated warehouse-arrival time and international route separately. A seller’s domestic dispatch is a different stage from international delivery. Use the route and restrictions shown for your actual destination and items; this independent guide cannot promise a delivery date or that every product can use every route.
https://usfans.com/help/category/all

name: Payments & returns
items: Which payment methods does USFans accept?

The official payment FAQ says international credit cards can be used. Available methods may depend on the account and checkout, so confirm the options and any charges directly on USFans. Do not send payment information to this site or to someone claiming to handle your order outside the official platform.
https://usfans.com/help/HCON_STATIC_035
What if USFans shows a payment error after I paid?

USFans advises contacting its online customer service with the relevant transaction details when a successful payment is shown as failed. Ask support to verify the transaction before retrying a charge you are unsure about. Use the account’s official support channel, and keep sensitive payment details out of public posts.
https://usfans.com/help/HCON_STATIC_035
Who pays USFans return or exchange shipping?

The return/exchange guarantee article distinguishes quality issues from change-of-mind requests. It says buyers cover shipping for eligible returns without a quality issue, while the seller covers it for a confirmed quality issue after a request. Resale condition, seller rules and the applicable service terms still matter. Check the current terms before assuming a request is free.
https://usfans.com/help/HCON_STATIC_006
Where do I request a USFans refund, return or exchange?

Use the relevant order’s After-sales action on USFans, and read the conditions presented for that order. A return request, acceptance by the seller, refund processing and withdrawal are different steps. This site cannot approve a refund or promise how long those steps will take.
https://usfans.com/help/HCON_STATIC_006

name: Using Findsheet
items: Why are some USFans spreadsheet product details or photos incomplete?

We use the main FindSpreadsheet catalog. The preview can fall back to a dated listing snapshot when live access is unavailable. Some products have only one available image; we do not invent additional angles. Check the original listing and the current USFans product page before buying.
Are USFans image search, sorting and live QC connected?

Keyword search covers all 8,911 catalog products by name, category, product ID and image filename. Image search compares your photo against catalog images in your browser. Product pages show available purchase-page images and separately labeled QC sources. Personal warehouse photos remain in your USFans account.
How should I choose a size from USFans clothing or shoe finds?

Use the seller’s measurements and compare them with an item you already own. For shoes, check the stated sizing system and available insole measurements; for clothing, compare chest, length, shoulder and sleeve dimensions where supplied. A spreadsheet category or title cannot guarantee the fit of a particular seller’s item.
